home.title: Player Zero — Games and apps
home.description: Player Zero makes games and apps. In development: KEYCERTO, a rhythm game played on the keyboard, and Meloom, a companion app that shows your day as a room.
home.about: Player Zero is an independent developer of games and apps.

about.title: About Player Zero
about.description: Player Zero is an independent developer of games and apps, currently making KEYCERTO and Meloom.
about.lead: Player Zero is an independent developer of games and apps.
paragraphs: KEYCERTO is a rhythm game played on the keyboard: keep time with the music, and letters and short stories appear on paper. Meloom is a companion app that shows the weather and local time in a small room, with gifts, card packs and cards to collect. On Android, it can also show your calendar, read-only, if you choose.
Each product page lists the platforms it is being developed for, its current status, how it works and answers to common questions.
